description: Detection regression corpus (TECH-C6). Each trace replays a recorded scenario through PromotionEngine + MicGate.decide and asserts the produced verdict sequence matches the captured expectation, so a regression in PromotionEngine / MicGate is caught by CI. The first nine entries are synthetic seeds that lock in the format and cross-app scenarios; the teams_native_{rewalk,debounce,flicker}_end entries are real dogfood sessions derived from the daemon event log via scripts/extract_detection_trace.py (verdict sequence, leading signal, confirmed_by, flicker count and timing preserved; titles and pids redacted). The end9/end12/end13/end14/end15 and google_meet_browser_tab_away entries are END17's synthetic incident traces, built from the raw rows each END spec quotes and expected to reach no end (`expected_outcome: no_end`); T8 replaces them with raw extracted traces.
